title: Fixed Separated Beds and Rear Fence Jointer
description: One newly authored complete static long-bed jointer-style machine exterior. A footed low chamfered cabinet supports two separate long metal-looking beds with a genuine central transverse opening and a small fixed height difference. One complete blunt drum and shaft are recessed below that mouth on full bearing supports. A broad high rear fence spans both beds and is rooted by two complete bent support stays. A whole rounded raised mouth guard connects to its fixed side pivot and arm; a proud front panel and one blank switch finish the exterior. No old bandsaw or thickness-planer geometry is imported: the open-top long beds and independent fence differ from a tall band-wheel housing and from an overhead-head feed portal.
